master.definition_en: Infection with the respiratory syncytial virus, an RNA virus of the genus Pneumovirus, in the family Paramyxoviridae, which is characterized by the formation of syncytia in tissue culture. It causes minor respiratory infection with rhinitis and cough in adults, but is capable of causing severe bronchitis and bronchopneumonia in young children.

aliases_zh: 婴幼儿及老年RSV下呼吸道感染
curated.category: 急性呼吸道感染 (Acute Respiratory Infection)
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 冬春高发呼吸道病毒；是全球婴儿及早产儿急性毛细支气管炎与住院的首要病原，小婴儿因气道极窄可在1–3天内突发黏液栓阻塞、高碳酸血症呼吸衰竭与呼吸暂停；同时也是≥60岁老年人及心肺基础病患者被严重低估的急性重症肺炎与心衰诱因。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 目前已进入“可主动预防”全新时代，婴儿单剂长效预防性单抗（尼塞韦单抗，国内已上市）及成人/孕妇疫苗已获批，但一旦发生感染临床尚无安全高效的常规特异抗RSV药物，主要依靠氧疗、吸痰、水化及呼吸支持度过急性期（绝大多数可完全康复）。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: WHO 2025年RSV实况估测全球5岁以下儿童每年因RSV直接导致逾360万次住院与约100,000例死亡（97%发生于中低收入国家，约半数死亡在6月龄以内小婴儿；此外老年人群亦存在巨大未单独统计的住院与超额死亡负担）。
annual_deaths_global.source: WHO Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) Fact Sheet (2025)

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: RSV尚未列入中国国家法定传染病常规报告病种，尚无全国单列死亡计数；国内多中心儿科及全年龄哨点监测证实，RSV长期位居冬春季婴幼儿住院急性下呼吸道感染（ALRI）与毛细支气管炎首位病原。

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 几乎所有儿童在2岁前至少感染过一次RSV；全球婴儿ALRI相关住院近半数与之密切相关。
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 每年11月至次年3月在北方呈严峻冬春高峰、南方呈冬春或全年延长流行，常引起儿科急诊与PICU床位紧张。

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 小婴儿毛细支气管炎出现呼吸急促（>60次/分）、鼻翼扇动、三凹征、呼吸暂停、发绀或拒奶脱水即刻收住儿科/PICU；给予加温湿化鼻导管吸氧、轻柔吸痰清理鼻咽分泌物保证气道畅通及静脉/鼻饲营养液体维持（避免过度盲目使用全身激素及无效支气管舒张剂）；呼吸衰竭予CPAP、HFNC或有创机械通气。防重于治：新生儿及首流行季婴儿尽早注射尼塞韦单抗（Nirsevimab）免疫保护。

standard_drugs.name_zh: 尼塞韦单抗注射液（乐唯初）
standard_drugs.drug_class: 长效全人源抗RSV融合蛋白单克隆抗体（免疫预防）
standard_drugs.usage_role: 全球及中国首个获批面向所有健康新生儿及高危婴儿的一针长效保护整个流行季免疫预防单抗（2024年1月NMPA批准）
standard_drugs.cost_estimate_cny: 自费约2,000–3,000元/剂（视体重分50mg/100mg规格，各地疫苗接种或特需门诊）
standard_drugs.cost_source: 国内上市后公立医院及社区接种点自费定价公开报道

standard_drugs.drug_class: 短效β2肾上腺素能受体激动剂（对症气道解痉）
standard_drugs.usage_role: 对婴儿典型RSV毛细支气管炎不推荐无差别常规使用；仅对伴有显著喘息支气管痉挛表型者酌情短程试验性雾化评估

non_drug_therapies_zh: 加温湿化高流量吸氧（HFNC）、CPAP与气道精细雾化吸引护理
孕妇孕晚期免疫接种（Abrysvo，欧美已批）或新生儿季节性被动单抗预防
老年人（≥60岁）接种重组蛋白或mRNA RSV疫苗预防

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 2023–2024年全球迎来RSV预防井喷：Arexvy、Abrysvo及mRNA-1345（mRESVIA）三款成人/孕妇疫苗相继获欧美批准，尼塞韦单抗（乐唯初）于2024年1月在中国获批用于婴儿保护整个RSV季；治疗方面，中国自主研发口服RSV融合蛋白抑制剂齐瑞索韦（Ziresovir / AK0529）已率先完成全球/国内III期积极临床试验并递交新药上市审评，有望成为全球首款获批抗RSV治疗小分子药物。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 尚无正式获批上市的儿童/成人RSV特效治疗小分子口服药；尼塞韦单抗在中国自费近2,000–3,000元且尚未纳入免疫规划，普及率仍低；老年RSV疫苗在国内尚未大范围获批落地。

master.definition_en: Left ventricular non-compaction (LVNC) is characterized by prominent left ventricular trabeculae and deep inter-trabecular recesses. The myocardial wall is often thickened with a thin, compacted epicardial layer and a thickened endocardial layer. In some patients, LVNC is associated with left ventricular dilatation and systolic dysfunction, which can be transient in neonates.

master.definition_en: A rare genetic neurological disorder characterized by infantile or childhood onset of recurrent acute encephalopathic episodes with cerebellar and extrapyramidal involvement following febrile illnesses. master.definition_en: Atresia of small intestine is a special form of intestinal atresia with absence of mesentery, which is most likely due to an intrauterine intestinal vascular accident. Newborns are usually preterm infants with low birth-weights, that encounter feeding difficulties (including vomiting with initial feeds, which may later worsened and the abdomen becomes progressively distended) as well as failure to thrive. Affected children present disrupted bowel loops assuming a spiral configuration resembling an 'apple peel' and may have less than half of the normal length of the small bowel and a physiologically short bowel. Atresia of small intestine is characterized by jejunal atresia near the ligament of Treitz, foreshortened bowel, and a large mesenteric gap. The bowel distal to the atresia is precariously supplied. Atresia of small intestine may be a manifestation of cystic fibrosis. The most important cause of mortality is short bowel syndrome, encountered in 65% of cases.
synonyms_en: congenital atresia of the small intestine

master.definition_en: Autosomal dominant intermediate Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type A is a rare hereditary motor and sensory neuropathy characterized by intermediate motor median nerve conduction velocities (usually between 25 and 45 m/s) and signs of both demyelination and axonal degeneration in nerve biopsies. master.name_en: congenital muscular dystrophy-respiratory failure-skin abnormalities-joint hyperlaxity syndrome
master.definition_en: A rare congenital muscular dystrophy characterized by neonatal hypotonia, life-threatening respiratory failure, and feeding difficulties, furthermore by delayed motor development, severe muscle weakness predominantly affecting axial muscles (leading to poor head control, rigid cervical spine, and severe scoliosis), generalized joint laxity with no or mild contractures, as well as dry skin with follicular hyperkeratosis. People with this condition are missing genetic material located on the short arm (p) of chromosome 8 in each cell. The severity of the condition and the associated signs and symptoms vary based on the size and location of the deletion and which genes are involved. Most cases are not inherited, although affected people can pass the deletion on to their children. Treatment is based on the signs and symptoms present in each person.

master.definition_en: Exogenous ochronosis refers tothe bluish-black discoloration of certain tissues, such as the ear cartilage, the ocular (eye) tissue, and other body locations when it is due toexposure to various substances.It has been reported most commonly with topical application of hydroquinones to the skin. The discolorationmay becaused byan effect ontyrosinase(an enzyme located in melanocytes, which are skincells that produce pigment), or by inhibiting homogentisic acid oxidase, resulting in the accumulation and deposition of homogentisic acid (HGA) in cartilage. The discoloration is often permanent, but when exogenous ochronosis is caused by topical hydroquinones, carbon dioxide lasers and dermabrasion have been reported to be helpful. Exogenous ochronosis is different from hereditary ochronosis, which is an inherited condition that occurs with alkaptonuria.

master.name_en: painful legs and moving toes syndrome
master.definition_en: A rare neurologic (adult-onset) movement disorder characterized by persistent pain (unilateral or bilateral) in the feet or legs (most commonly the hemi-lower limbs) and persistant twisting, non-rhythmic, involuntary movements of one or more toes. Chronic "deep aching pulling pain" includes tingling, numbness, aching, dullness, cramp, shooting, sharp, burning, and prickling.

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 睡梦与突发危象的实时监测预警
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 在数分钟至数小时黄金窗到来前，提前发出异常信号
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 以遗传性易栓症、急性肺栓塞、主动脉夹层、恶性心律失常和脑出血为代表的急症，平时毫无征兆，往往在睡梦中或静息状态下几分钟内危及生命——家人根本来不及反应。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 需要发展连续无创可穿戴微循环/血氧/心电多模态传感器、血液微凝血活性快速试纸，结合 AI 在异常触发前几小时识别微血栓与高危信号并立即叫醒预警。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 时序多模态生理异常检测 + 血液高凝状态前置生物标志物发现 + 低成本家系表型筛查算法。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 急诊极危重期的快速再通与器官细胞保护
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把“几分钟决定生死”的抢救窗口拓宽成“几小时可救回”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 对急性心梗、脑梗死、脓毒性休克、急性肝衰竭与热射病而言，哪怕送到急诊室，微血管再灌注损伤、细胞因子风暴和不可逆线粒体坏死仍会在短时间内夺走生命。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 研发免复杂配型的超快精准溶栓与导管微取栓器械、阻断微血栓级联炎症风暴药物，以及在缺血缺氧期守住心肌与脑神经元存活的细胞保护剂。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 急性多器官微循环级联动力学建模、急诊快速炎症/凝血表型分型、老药新用紧急器官保护筛选。

master.definition_en: Abnormal fluid retention by the body due to impaired cardiac function or heart failure. It is usually characterized by increase in venous and capillary pressure, and swollen legs when standing. It is different from the generalized edema caused by renal dysfunction (NEPHROTIC SYNDROME).
